title: APPLICATION_ADMIN and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE stay with the timelock across every grant, revoke and renounce, executed or not (AdminRoleOnlyTimelock)
Witness: the timelock grants a guardian role to a Safe, while the same operation granting APPLICATION_ADMIN reverts
Initializers grant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and APPLICATION_ADMIN only to the TIMELOCK constant (any other argument reverts)
Every Adapter upgrade is a timelock operation every canceller can cancel: a role-change operation cannot hand out upgrade power
Every page names the same allowed caller for each privileged selector, including the address freeze, breaker and standby selectors
Guardian keys reach exactly freeze, pause, unfreeze, unpause, freezeAddress, breaker trip and reset, useStandbyRoute and cancel; never unfreezeAddress, an upgrade, a setter or a route choice
A key holding only APPLICATION_FREEZE_GUARDIAN can call no lifting selector (unfreeze, unpause, breaker reset, address unfreeze)
Every APPLICATION_ADMIN or TIMELOCK selector runs only as a timelock execution
PositionProxy.execute succeeds only for msg.sender == ADAPTER, never for its own wallet, and never targets the proxy itself, address 0 or an address without code
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: supply, borrow, repay and withdrawal are Adapter logic sent through execute.

title: Witness: the Adapter's execute call to the Spoke succeeds

The PositionProxy selector inventory is execute plus four views, with no generic multicall, delegatecall, signature, receiver, manager, upgrade, initializer or role selector; the Adapter's call builder never sends a liquidation, position-manager or risk-premium selector
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the named supply, borrow, repay and withdraw functions of the old proxy are replaced by execute.

title: No hostile RiskModule, ParameterStore, MarketRegistry, LPOracle, DebtOracle, LPVaultSwap or IFlashSource implementation reaches mint, proxy registration, position return, fee collection, stray return, or flash-source replacement
Methodology T-65 names only contained components (the AaveAdapter, which reaches mint and proxy registration, is in the reviewed scope instead)

Every Collateralization and LPVault effect that moves a position, a token or a ledger amount is reachable only from a call tree opened by AaveAdapter or LPVaultSwap, the Lock's two members; the timelock reaches only returnStray of a never-recorded position, with the Lock free
